summary: Implement Phase4 with a compact bridge provider payload, lazy model fetches, a reusable ModelSelect component, and bounded model chips.
goal: Improve LLM connection UX for large provider catalogs without adding dependencies or changing credential storage.

changes.change: Make ProviderStatus model payload optional-compatible, return models=[] by default, and include model_count.
changes.reason: Reduce /providers payload while preserving model availability metadata.
changes.verification: bun run typecheck and registry tests

changes.change: Support /providers?include_models=true and remove the unused /providers/models route.
changes.reason: Keep per-provider /providers/{id}/models as the model catalog SSOT.
changes.verification: server tests for compact, include_models, and 404 all-model route

changes.change: Add dependency-free fuzzy search, dropdown, keyboard selection, loading indicator, and manual input support.
changes.reason: Replace datalist prefix matching across all model entry surfaces.
changes.verification: npm run typecheck and npm run build

changes.change: Use ModelSelect in quick connect, active model, and advanced default model fields; add in-memory lazy model cache, loading/error states, and chip expansion.
changes.reason: Keep initial provider load compact and make OpenRouter-sized catalogs usable.
changes.verification: npm run typecheck, npm run build, and smoke check

changes.change: Add field warning, model chip expand/collapse styles, and rebuilt hashed assets.
changes.reason: Show lazy-load failures and bound expanded chip lists visually.

changes.change: Update and add tests for compact status, opt-in full status, and removed all-model route.
changes.reason: Prevent regression of Phase4 bridge behavior.

migration_or_compatibility: /providers?include_models=true remains available for clients that need full provider status payloads.
/providers/{id}/models remains the supported model catalog endpoint.
/providers/models now returns 404 by design per Phase4 F-1 A.
risks: A third-party caller relying on /providers/models must move to /providers?include_models=true or per-provider model calls.
Browser-only manual UX was not screenshot-tested in this run; build and smoke verify packaged UI integrity.
rollback: Restore the previous /providers models payload and allModels route if compatibility requires it.
Revert ModelSelect usage to datalist inputs if a frontend regression appears.
definition_of_done: Frontend typecheck and production build pass
Payload probe shows compact /providers is smaller than include_models
build.sh smoke confirms packaged web UI serves
